description:
Pull one component's full source code to reuse in the project, with its licence, copyright
    holder, GitHub permalink and an attribution header to keep with the copied code. Cost: 1 credit
    per call (needs a free key; refunded if the id is not available). Re-pulling a component you
    already pulled still costs 1 credit.

    Parameters: id (required) -- a component id from search_components or find_similar.

    Returns JSON with the full source, licence, attribution header, GitHub permalink, repo, path,
    language and quality scores.

    Example: get_component(id="<id from search_components>")
name: get_component
title: Get component source
